title: How a checkout request flows
summary: The gateway authenticates, then the service reads the database and calls tax-service.
author: agent

blocks.title: Request flow
blocks.caption: Dotted line: token validation.
blocks.source:
flowchart LR
  U[Client] --> G[Gateway]
  G --> A[Auth]
  G --> S[Service]
  S --> D[(Database)]
  A -. token .-> S

blocks.title: Sequence
blocks.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant S as Server
  C->>S: request
  S-->>C: response

blocks.title: Notes
blocks.text:
Auth results are cached for 60 seconds.

- The database is the only stateful hop.
- tax-service is called synchronously.
